title: Ask HN: What if anyone could sell AI tokens from their idle GPU?
excerpt: I have an idea: what if everyone could turn their own GPU into an API and put it on a network for other people to use?
content_html:
I have an idea: what if everyone could turn their own GPU into an API and put it on a network for other people to use?

Then we could build something similar to OpenRouter.

I’m also thinking about offering a $10/month plan.

Would you guys be interested in joining?
